Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Phylissa usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Φυλίσσα
in_greek.meaning: Φυλίσσα σημαίνει βαθιά αγάπη ή φιλία
